justification: Both are upright stone monuments with relief carving arranged in horizontal registers, but the actual subject matter differs sharply: A depicts a series of stylized animals (birds with long necks, quadrupeds) in a schematic naturalistic style, while B depicts a single blocky anthropomorphic figure with facial features and hands meeting at the belly, typical of ancestor-figure statuary. The correspondence is limited to the generic fact of carved figural relief on a stone slab, not to any specific shared motif, posture, or relationship between elements.
